requirement: Register with the ODPC as a data controller and renew before expiry
source: Data Protection Act 2019, s.18; Data Protection (Registration of Data Controllers and Data Processors) Regulations 2021
test_step: Inspect evidence that the obligation is met (odpc registration certificate) and test the control

requirement: Process personal data only on a lawful basis and in line with the data protection principles
source: Data Protection Act 2019, s.25 and s.30
test_step: Inspect evidence that the obligation is met (record of processing activities with lawful bases) and test the control
evidence_requested: Record of processing activities with lawful bases

requirement: Tell people what data is collected, why, and their rights (privacy notices, CCTV signs)
source: Data Protection Act 2019, s.29
test_step: Inspect evidence that the obligation is met (published privacy notices and photos of cctv signs) and test the control
evidence_requested: Published privacy notices and photos of CCTV signs

requirement: Handle data subject requests (access, correction, deletion, objection) within the prescribed time
source: Data Protection Act 2019, s.26; Data Protection (General) Regulations 2021
test_step: Inspect evidence that the obligation is met (data subject request log) and test the control

requirement: Notify the ODPC of a personal data breach within 72 hours, and affected people without undue delay where there is real risk of harm
source: Data Protection Act 2019, s.43
test_step: Inspect evidence that the obligation is met (breach log and breach response procedure) and test the control
evidence_requested: Breach log and breach response procedure

requirement: Carry out a data protection impact assessment before high-risk processing

requirement: Use written contracts with data processors that require security and confidentiality

test_step: Inspect evidence that the obligation is met (signed data processing agreements) and test the control

requirement: Transfer personal data outside Kenya only with appropriate safeguards
